body.text: Unless the factories change, it will get worse.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: Most of the litter comes from the town, not the factories.

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: Some of it does. But all of the worst waste comes from up the valley.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: None of my neighbours know that.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: My students could clean the river bank on Saturday.

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: Both of us will come. How many students?

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: About twenty. Most of them said yes at once.

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: Good. Bring bags, and we will start at nine.
